Blushcraft is a two-player, blush-inducing card game for romantic and playful moments. Play Host/Join over Nearby Connections in the same room, or pair online with WebRTC + QR so round data stays on your phones.

### Highlights

- Host / Join nearby, Host / Join online (QR), and Practice mode
- Riskay slider mixes innocent ↔ spicy card packs
- First to 5 points wins and picks a prize
- Live reaction PiP (camera + mic) with privacy toggles

## Install

1. Download **`app-release.apk`** below (signed; recommended for everyday use).
2. Install on two Android phones running **API 26+**.
3. For nearby play, keep **Location** and **Bluetooth** on.
4. Allow camera/mic if you want reaction video (either can be muted in-app).

```bash
adb install -r app-release.apk
```

### Automatic updates (Obtainium)

Install [Obtainium](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium), add GitHub repo **`electrikjesus/Blushcraft`**, filter releases to **`app-release.apk`**, and it will track new **`v*`** tags from this page. See [docs/distribution.md](https://github.com/electrikjesus/Blushcraft/blob/main/docs/distribution.md).

More detail: [README](https://github.com/electrikjesus/Blushcraft/blob/main/README.md) · [Report issues](https://github.com/electrikjesus/Blushcraft/issues)
